name: themicro
summary: Next.js repo for a library of micro-interactions, sounds and transition components.
description: Repository of a curated micro-interaction, sound and transition component library, built as a Next.js 16 app with React 19, framer-motion, Tailwind CSS 4 and TypeScript; it ships AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for coding agents and a live demo at the-micro.vercel.app. The README is still the create-next-app starter text, the demo host did not respond, and the repo has no license file.
contains: Next.js 16 + React 19 app; framer-motion 13, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript
